request.description:
This endpoint takes the original header, body, URL and request method, delivers it to a specific service and replaces some card data with vault tokens in the response.

The original means that this is the exact data that a particular service expects to receive.

The service is detected automatically. However, it must be previously connected (See the endpoint **services create** with the `proxy_link` group).

All card data (except for the number and CVV), external IDs and vault tokens can also be obtained with *get by ID* and *search* endpoints.


## Request headers 
    
| field | required | type | description |
|--|--|--|--|
|x-original-url | + | string | URL |
|x-original-method | + | string | HTTP methods: `GET`, `POST` |
|x-original-[any] | - | string | Any original header |
| x-virtual-flow | - | string | It allows simulating some positive and negative responses for testing needs. It works only with a virtual mode. By default, it is always a positive response. See *Virtual Flow* table  |

## Request body 

The original body that a particular service expects to receive.

## Response body 

The original body that a particular service is expected to return with sanitized card number and CVV.

## Response headers 
    
| field | required | type | description |
|--|--|--|--|
|x-fetch-id | + | string (24 byte hex) | A fetch ID for any future requests |
|x-response-source | + | string | If you received a response from an external service (OTA), the header value will always be `external`. Values can be `internal` or `external`|
|x-original-[any] | - | string | Any original response header |

## Virtual flow

| flow | description |
| -- | -- |
| unauthorized | The case when the auth data is incorrect or not provided |
| no_cvv | The case when CVV was not provided |
| without_card | The case when payment details were not provided in a booking request |

item.description:
Every proxy request generates a fetch entity that includes common information and relations with vaults etc.


## Fetch resource 

| field | required [flow] | type | description |
|--|--|--|--|
| _id | + | string (24 byte hex) | A charge ID for any future requests |
| created_at | + | string (ISO 8601 format: yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss.sssZ) | The date of the fetch creation |
| updated_at | + | string (ISO 8601 format: yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss.sssZ) | The date of the last fetch update |
| status | + | string | An actual fetch status. See the *status* table |
| archived | + | bool | For a newly created fetch, it is always *false*. It is set to *true* after manual archivation |
| logs | + | Array<Object> | The list of request and response logs |
| service_id | + | string (24 byte hex) | A proxy link service ID used for a fetch request |
| mode | + | string (24 byte hex) | A proxy link service mode used for a fetch request. See *service endpoints* for more information about the modes  |
| response_properties | - | Array< Array< Object > > | Every payment source property is presented in the form of a structure with detailed information |
| response_properties[][].type | + | string | A type of the parsed property. See *Property types* table |
| response_properties[][].sanitized_as | + | string | A type of the sanitizer applied to this property. See *Sanitize types* table |
| response_properties[][].value | + | string | An original or sanitized value according to the sanitize type rules |
| response_properties[][].path | + | string | A path to the property in the original response body |

## Fetch status

| status | description |
| -- | -- |
| completed | A successful fetch request |
| failed | An unsuccessful (failed) fetch request |
| inprogress | A system state of a transaction while it is sending a request to a payment gateway |


## Sanitize types

| status | description |
| -- | -- |
| original | The value remained unchanged |
| cvv_vault | The value was replaced with a CVV vault token  |
| card_number_vault | The value was replaced with a card vault token |

## Property types

| status | description |
| -- | -- |
| cardholder_name | Cardholder name |
| card_number | Card number |
| card_cvv | Card CVV number |
| expire_month | Card expiry month |
| expire_year | Card expiry year |
| actual_till | An expiration date of the CVV vault token. For example, the final date of the reservation. |
| external_id | The original external_id, i.e. the ID of the entity which was generated on the OTA provider's side |
